claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bremen (Brem.), Neumber[?], Bremen June 17th, via
Southampton 20th, with mdse. and 673 pass. to Oelrichs & Co. Had
westerly winds the entire passage. June 17, off Borkum (North Sea)
passed bark Lizzie Morrow, of St. Johns, N. B., bound E; 20th, off
Eddystone, steamship Teutonia, bound E; 23d, lat. 49[?] 21, long. 23 48[?],
Br. bark Memento, bound E; same day, 6 p. m., lat. 49 19, long. 23 57,
steamship Allemania, bound E; 24th, steamship Baltic, bound E;
27th, lat. 43[?] 57, long. 45[?] 43[?], steamship Somerset, bound E; 29th, lat.
42[?] 05, long. 53[?] 39, steamship City of Dublin, from Liverpool for New-
York; July 1, lat. 40 16, long. 70[?] 27, steamship Western Metropolis,
bound E.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Sandy Hook 256 miles from Sandy Hook (July 1 2 p. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Boston, Brooks, Liverpool June 20, and Queens-
town 21st, with mdse. and 734 pass. to John G. Dale. June 20, 4:35 p.
m., off Ormes's Head, passed steamship City of Cork; 21st, 4 a. m.,
20[?] miles N. E.[?] of Tuskar, passed steamship City of Paris, bound up;
23d, 2 p. m., lat. 50 50, long. 20 36, Edinburgh, bound E; 24th at noon,
lat. 50[?] 25, long. 26 24[?], Bosphorus, bound W; 28th, 3:30 a. m., lat. 46 46,
long. 48 46, passed brig-rigged steamer bound W, supposed the Tripoli;
July 1, 2 p. m., 256 miles from Sandy Hook, saw steamship City of
New-York, The Queen, and City of Dublin.
